name: Ram Ratna Wires Ltd
about: Ram Ratna Wires Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of winding wires, mainly enamelled copper wires. [1]
keyPoints:
Market Position
The company is the 2nd largest manufacturer of Winding Wire in South Asia. It is the only manufacturer of enameled copper wires in India that offers the widest range, from the thinnest wire of 18 microns (0.018mm) to 4.876 mm with intermediate sizes. [1]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 19.9%
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.20%
